天圆地方，雪谷深处。净神机立于冰隙之外，身后是黑压压列阵的魔兽军团。
他望着脚下那道通往冰窟的裂隙，嘴角挂着压抑已久的、终于得以舒展的笑意。
三年前，魔盟主派他来到俄城，任务只有两个：一是掌控这片极北之地，二是斩草除根——尤其是那位能以星光指引方向的城主俄擎苍，以及他的神兵兽北辰。
可北辰以最后的力量隐匿了星光，将主人藏入这片茫茫雪谷深处。净神机搜了三年，掘地三尺，连鹿角的影子都没找到。
直到他想起一个人。俄磊。俄擎苍的儿子，俄城的少主，一个年仅十四岁、却要独自面对父亲失踪、妹妹叛逃的少年。
净神机太了解这种孩子了。越是聪明，越是重情，就越容易被
“孝心
“与
“责任
“这两根绳索牵着走。他不需亲自去搜，只需跟在俄磊身后，让这孩子替自己把父亲从藏身处
“找
“出来。他赌对了。净神机回头，望着身后蓄势待发的魔兽军团，轻声自语：“俄磊少爷，属下说过，会回来好好送您最后一程的。
“他抬手，向前一指。
“出发。
“冰窟内。俄磊仍跪在父亲身侧，肩头的刀伤已凝出血痂，与父亲肩臂上那道更深更长的伤口贴在一起，两人的血早已混得分不清你我。他没有动。他在听。冰隙外，风雪声中出现杂乱的、沉重的、成百上千的踏雪之音。魔兽军团的步伐。他等的，终于来了。俄磊垂下眼睫，将眼底所有的平静、冷峻、洞明都敛入深处。然后他抬起头，让那层早已练得炉火纯青的
“惊惧
“浮上脸庞。
“……净神机。
“他的声音嘶哑，带着恰到好处的颤抖。俄擎苍仍昏迷不醒。北辰瘫倒在冰壁下，鹿角裂痕累累，那缕笼罩在主人心口的星光已微弱如风中残烛。他独自一人，面对即将涌入的黑暗大军。——这正是他盼望的。冰隙上方，第一头魔兽探出头来。那是一头浑身覆盖霜甲、獠牙倒卷的冰原巨狼。它猩红的眼珠向下搜寻，锁定冰窟中的少年，喉间发出低沉的呜咽。俄磊后退一步，将父亲护在身后。更多魔兽从冰隙边缘探出头来。霜甲狼、冰脊熊、寒齿虎……一头接一头，密密麻麻，几乎将整个冰隙围成铁桶。净神机从魔兽群中缓步走出，居高临下地俯视着冰窟中的猎物。

“俄磊少爷，
“他慢悠悠开口，
“属下说过，您逃不掉的。
“俄磊没有答话。他死死攥紧父亲的衣襟，肩头剧烈颤抖。净神机欣赏着这一幕，并未急于下令。他要让这少年在绝望中多煎熬片刻。就在此时——一道冰蓝剑光从魔兽军团后方破空而来！
“道晶兽，变身！
“公道的力量，变身道晶！
“剑光如虹，贯入一头霜甲狼的脊背！魔兽惨嚎一声，翻滚坠入冰隙。紧随剑光之后，数道身影如鹰隼般掠过魔兽群，直扑冰窟！台焕第一个落地，道晶剑横于身前，将俄磊父子护在身后。鹰捷紧跟着跃下，太极统炮口已亮起蓄势的光芒。小青鹰立在他肩头，青羽炸开，发出尖锐的警戒鸣叫。玉兔龙从台灵怀中跃出，一口微火喷向最近的那头冰脊熊，逼得它后退半步。俄莹抱着雪瞳兽，最后一个落入冰窟。她的蓝眸扫过父亲肩臂上那道深可见骨的刀伤、兄长肩侧干涸的血痂、以及瘫倒在冰壁下、鹿角裂痕累累的北辰，眼眶骤然泛红。但她没有哭。她只是将雪瞳兽抱得更紧。净神机瞳孔骤缩。
“你们……怎么会……
“冰－激－凌那蠢货传消息的时候，
“鹰捷咧嘴一笑，
“可没说自己在哪座雪山底下。
“他顿了顿，炮口对准净神机：“但他逃跑的路线，雪地上可都留着印子呢。
“净神机脸色铁青。他不再多言，抬手猛挥：“杀！一个不留！
“魔兽军团蜂拥而下！这一战，从冰窟内打到冰隙外，从雪谷深处打到谷口崖壁。台焕的道晶剑在兽群中穿梭如电，每一次斩击都精准落在魔兽要害。鹰捷的太极统吞吐不定，时而化冰锥贯透坚甲，时而喷火柱阻断追击。小青鹰虽年幼，却以惊人的敏捷穿梭于魔兽头顶，以稚嫩的翅风扰乱它们的视线。玉兔龙守在台灵身侧，微火喷吐，将试图靠近的魔兽逼得不敢上前。魔兽一头接一头倒下。净神机站在战圈之外，看着自己的军团被这几个孩子撕开一道又一道缺口，面色阴沉得可怕。他低估了这群小崽子。但他还有底牌。
“黑暗黑雪鹅！
“他厉声喝道，
“出战！
“冰隙上空，骤然暗下。那不是乌云——是密密麻麻、几乎遮蔽天穹的漆黑巨鸟。它们通体覆盖墨色绒羽，身形浑圆如球，喙与爪却泛着金属般的冷光。每一头黑暗黑雪鹅张开喙时，那黑洞洞的口腔都仿佛能吞噬一切光芒——以及攻击。第一头黑雪鹅俯冲而下，鹰捷对准它轰出一发炽焰喷射。火焰没入巨鸟口中，如同泥牛入海，无声无息。

The sky is round and the earth is round, deep in the snow valley. The Jingshenji stood outside the ice crevice, with a black army of Warcraft behind it.
He looked at the crack leading to the ice cave under his feet, with a smile that had been suppressed for a long time and finally relaxed.
Three years ago, the leader of the Demon Alliance sent him to Ercheng with only two tasks: one is to control this far north land, and the other is to eradicate the roots - especially the city lord Er Qingcang who can guide the direction with starlight, and his divine weapon Beichen.
But Beichen used his last strength to hide the starlight and hide his master deep in this vast snow valley. Jingshenji searched for three years and dug three feet into the ground, but couldn't find even the shadow of antlers.
Until he remembered someone. Orei. The son of Er Qingcang, the young master of Er City, a boy who is only fourteen years old, but has to face the disappearance of his father and the defection of his sister alone.
Jingshenji knows this kind of child very well. The smarter you are and the more affectionate you are, the easier it is to be
"Filial piety
"With
"Responsibility
"These two ropes lead each other. He didn't need to search himself, he just had to follow Orei and let the child take his father out of hiding for him.
"Looking for
"Come out. He made the right bet. Jingshenji turned around, looked at the army of Warcraft behind him that was preparing to attack, and whispered to himself: "Master Olei, my subordinates said that they will come back to see you off on your last journey.
"He raised his hand and pointed forward.
"Let's go.
"Inside the ice cave. Olei was still kneeling beside his father. The knife wound on his shoulder had formed a scab of blood, and it was stuck together with the deeper and longer wound on his father's shoulder and arm. The blood of the two of them had long been mixed together and they could not be distinguished from each other. He didn't move. He is listening. Outside the ice crevice, there was a messy, heavy sound of hundreds of thousands of people stepping on the snow amidst the sound of wind and snow. The pace of the Warcraft Legion. What he had been waiting for was finally here. Olei lowered his eyelashes and gathered all the calmness, coldness, and clarity in his eyes into the depths. Then he raised his head and let the layer of people who had already practiced it with great proficiency
"Fear
"Face up.
"...Jingshenji.
"His voice was hoarse, with just the right amount of trembling. Er Qingcang is still unconscious. Beichen collapsed under the ice wall, his antlers were full of cracks, and the starlight shrouding his master's heart was as weak as a candle in the wind. He was alone, facing the incoming army of darkness. ——This is exactly what he hopes for. Above the ice crevice, the first monster poked its head out. It was a giant ice wolf covered in frost armor and with its fangs curled back. Its scarlet eyes searched downwards, locking onto the young man in the ice cave, and let out a low whimper from its throat. O Lei took a step back and protected his father behind him. More monsters poked their heads out from the edge of the ice crevice. Frost-armored wolves, ice-backed bears, cold-toothed tigers... one after another, densely packed, almost surrounding the entire ice crevice into an iron barrel. Jingshenji slowly walked out from the group of monsters and looked down at the prey in the ice cave.
"Master Olei,
"He spoke slowly,
"My subordinate said that you can't escape.
"Olei didn't answer. He clutched his father's shirt tightly, his shoulders shaking violently. Jing Shenji admired this scene and was not in a hurry to give orders. He wanted the young man to suffer in despair for a while longer. At this moment - a ray of ice-blue sword light came from behind the Warcraft Legion!
“Dao Crystal Beast, transform!
"The power of justice, transform into Dao Crystal!
"The sword light was like a rainbow, penetrating into the back of a frost-armored wolf! The monster howled miserably, and rolled into the ice crevice. Following the sword light, several figures flew past the group of monsters like hawks, and rushed straight into the ice cave! Tai Huan was the first to land, with the Dao Crystal Sword lying across his body, protecting O Lei and his son behind him. Ying Jie jumped down immediately, and the muzzle of the Taijitong gun lit up with a charged light. The little green eagle stood beside him. Green feathers exploded on her shoulders, letting out a sharp warning cry. The Jade Rabbit Dragon jumped out of Tai Ling's arms and sprayed a small fire at the nearest ice-spine bear, forcing it to take a half step back. The last one fell into the ice cave. Her blue eyes glanced at the bone-deep knife wound on her father's shoulder and arm, and the dried blood scab on her brother's shoulder, as well as the deer's antlers that collapsed under the ice wall.The cracked Beichen's eyes suddenly turned red. But she didn't cry. She just hugged the snow-eyed beast tighter. Jingshenji's pupils shrank suddenly.
"How could you...
"When that idiot Ice Cream sent the message,
"Yingjie grinned,
“I didn’t say which snow mountain I was under.
He paused and pointed the muzzle at Jingshenji: "But the route he took to escape left marks on the snow."
"Jingshenji's face was ashen. He said no more, raised his hand and waved violently: "Kill! Leave no one behind!
"The Warcraft Legion swarmed down! This battle started from the ice cave to the outside of the ice crevice, from the depths of the snow valley to the cliff at the mouth of the valley. Tai Huan's Dao Crystal Sword shuttled through the beasts like lightning, and every slash landed accurately on the key points of the Warcraft. Ying Jie's Tai Chi was hesitant, sometimes turning into ice cones to penetrate the armor, sometimes spitting fire pillars to block the pursuit. Although the little green eagle was young, it shuttled through the Warcraft with astonishing agility. The beasts' heads were disturbed by the immature wings of the wind. The Jade Rabbit Dragon stood by Tai Ling's side and breathed out fire, forcing the monsters that tried to get closer to fall down one after another. Jing Shenji stood outside the battle circle, looking at his legion being torn apart by these children, with a terrifying look on his face. But he still had a trump card.
“Dark Black Snow Goose!
he shouted sharply,
“Go to war!
"Over the ice crevice, it suddenly darkened. Those were not dark clouds - they were densely packed dark giant birds that almost covered the sky. They were covered with ink feathers, and their bodies were as round as balls, but their beaks and claws glowed with a metallic cold light. Each dark and black snow goose When it opened its beak, the black mouth seemed to be able to swallow up all light - and attacks. The first black snow goose swooped down, and Eagle Jet fired a jet of blazing flames at it.
"...What?
"Yingjie was stunned. Another black snow goose pounced on Tai Huan, and the Daojing sword slashed on its dark down feathers.
